Default.desc: You can choose from the available default fonts in the drop-down menu. These fonts are available within the **Workspace** for easy selection.

Font.desc: This setting allows you to modify the font used for displaying content. By clicking on the drop-down, you can select available default fonts, based on your preferences.

Custom.desc: This option allows you to upload and use your own fonts, either by providing a link or uploading a font file. You can choose fonts from open-source libraries or other sources.

Font Link.desc: Enter the font link from an open-source font provider, such as Google Fonts. Example: https://fonts.google.com/share?selection.family=Roboto.

Font File.desc: Upload the font file that you want to use in your branding.
